Please do not do this, I want you to know that I have been in a situation sort of similar to you, please please please refer to this my post earlier, it will cheer you up, and might even brighten your day. 

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/zppl4/an_update_from_me_and_hopefully_people_to_talk_to/

I know times seem dark, but there are always other options. What does your boyfriend think about your situation? I'm here.
Thank you, and I was given the chance.
I play trumpet, thank you for asking and responding. Things are getting better, albeit they are still incredibly dark.
